title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Rider: Tier Entry Schedule
content:
Each PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) tier admits a service account on four entry gates: the official rate schedule of the underlying service account, the member type on the member profile, the meter the service account carries, and the total arrears transferred onto the enrollment. A tier is assigned only where all four fit.

## Entry gates by tier

| Tier | Rate schedules admitted | Member types admitted | Meter required | Transferred arrears band (USD, inclusive) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PrePay Power Residential | Schedule R Residential Service; Schedule FH Farm and Home Service | individual, joint | AMI meter with remote disconnect | 0.00 through 0.00 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 | Schedule R Residential Service; Schedule FH Farm and Home Service | individual, joint | AMI meter with remote disconnect | 0.01 through 500.00 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 | Schedule R Residential Service; Schedule FH Farm and Home Service | individual, joint | AMI meter with remote disconnect | 500.01 through 1500.00 |
| PrePay Power Seasonal | Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service | individual, joint | AMI meter with remote disconnect | 0.00 through 250.00 |
| PrePay Power Outbuilding | Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service, with no dwelling on the meter | individual, joint | AMI meter with remote disconnect | 0.00 through 250.00 |
| PrePay Power Small Commercial | Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service | business, nonprofit | AMI meter with remote disconnect | 0.00 through 0.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The band runs from the tier's lowest transferred arrears through its highest transferred arrears, both ends included. PrePay Power Residential and PrePay Power Small Commercial admit only an enrollment that transfers no arrears at all (0.00).
2. On Schedule R and Schedule FH the three residential tiers divide the arrears range without overlap: 0.00 belongs to PrePay Power Residential, 0.01 through 500.00 to PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25, and 500.01 through 1500.00 to PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40.
3. The meter gate is the same on every tier: the service account must carry an AMI meter with remote disconnect.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical cases)

- A joint member on Schedule FH transferring 500.00 sits at the top of the PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 band; at 500.01 the same account falls in the PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 band.
- A nonprofit on Schedule GS-1 transferring 0.00 fits PrePay Power Small Commercial; an individual on Schedule GS-1 with no dwelling on the meter transferring 250.00 fits PrePay Power Outbuilding, and at 250.01 fits no Outbuilding band.
